title: AWS Lambda to get and update SSM values
description: AWS Lambda GET and PUT to Amazon SSM Parameter Store

introBox.headline: Create a Lambda function that GETs and PUTs entries in SSM.
text: This Serverless Framework project deploys a Lambda function, and returns values from SSM and also a method to update the value in SSM.
See the GitHub repo for detailed testing instructions.
2. Confirm the stack has been deleted: aws cloudformation list-stacks --query "StackSummaries[?contains(StackName,'STACK_NAME')].StackStatus"
